actions.kind: Button (primary), inside a form with submit suppressed
actions.outcome: Trims the field. Empty: sets the invalid ring, stops. Otherwise writes the value into every .badge-name element, stores it in the browser's localStorage key drivesafe_badge_name (this device only), shows the success toast. Verified on the running prototype (Playwright, 2026-10-26): pressing Enter in the field saves exactly as the button does (value stored, toast shown, no page reload; the Update button is the form's default submit button). Pressing Enter on a blank field sets aria-invalid and shows nothing else
actions.who_may: any signed-in user (prototype enforces nothing; Administrator-only is PROPOSED, OQ-12-04)

validation.when: Update only (no blur validation, no live clearing because the field has no aria-describedby)
validation.message: Badge Name is required. (see invisibility defect)

states.shows: Field holds the saved badge name (seed "Ministry of Transport and Mining", or the value restored from localStorage)

states.when: Update pressed with empty or blank field
states.shows: Field gets a red ring and aria-invalid. The text "Badge Name is required." is not visible: the markup has no #err-cfg-badge element, so the message is lost (OQ-12-02). No capture exists of this state
Toast Config updated. Badge Name set to "{value}".; auth screens show the new text immediately
None exist; a settings form has no empty state. Permission undefined, OQ-12-04

steps.text: I open Settings > Config for the first time
Badge Name reads "Ministry of Transport and Mining"
I replace the text with "Jamaica Transport Authority" and press Update
a toast reads Config updated. Badge Name set to "Jamaica Transport Authority".
after signing out the sign-in screen shows that text under "Admin Portal"
I clear the field and press Update
the field is outlined red and the saved value is unchanged
a visible "Badge Name is required." message is shown (currently missing in the prototype, see OQ-12-02)
I reload the page and open Config
I enter only spaces and press Update
it is treated as empty and rejected
